correctness.rationale: Full-subposet one-skeleton on k vertices has k(k-1) distinct directed-word 1-cells, connected H1 rank (k-1)^2. Actual Lü–Panov Corollary 3.8 puts each integral support in degree k+2, giving binom(n,k)(k-1)^2 and no torsion. For permutations preserving a support, exterior u-generator reordering twists graph cellular cohomology by sgn_k; explicit oriented chain traces have C1=f(f-1), C0=f, H0=1, hence L_k character (f-1)^2. Edge/vertex ordered-pair modules by stabilizer and Frobenius reciprocity give sign multiplicity exactly one at k=3, zero at k=2 or k>=4. Since rational finite-group orbit cohomology is invariants, quotient has only H0 and H5 for n>=3, with product zero; n=2 has no positive rational invariants. Verified n=2 transposition sign and k=3 multiplicity via independent Frobenius count. Submitted verify.py constructs local Koszul differential and checks permutation characters n<=6; finite tests corroborate, not prove, all-n quantifiers. Not a claim of rational homotopy equivalence.

value.rationale: The truncation isolates a nontrivial persistent invariant under increasingly large permutation groups, sharply contrasting the full-word quotient.
